review_evidence: Grep over 234 files: 226 files have one or more declaration/command lines; 8 have zero matches.

HexGFqMathlib/Embeddings.lean and HexGFqMathlib/Primitivity.lean: read completely; module header, public imports of the S0..S4 split modules, `public section`; import-only aggregators, retained under FILTER-007.

HexGramSchmidt/Basic.lean, HexGramSchmidt/Int.lean, HexSmith/Correct.lean: read completely; public imports of subject splits plus module docstrings describing the Gram-Schmidt and Smith normal form correctness surfaces; import aggregators with navigation documentation, retained under FILTER-007.
HexLLL/Certificate.lean: read completely; a single `public import HexMatrix.Certificate` with a compatibility docstring; import aggregator, retained under FILTER-007.

experiments/CadSampleCosts/Emit.lean: read completely; eight `#cad_emit` commands that state real-closed-field propositions such as `∀ t : ℝ, t^2-2=0 → 1<t → t<2 → 5*t^2+8*t-60<0`; formal statements, retained.

scripts/bench/GeneratePrimeTable.lean: read completely; imports HexPrimality.SieveElab and runs `#rebuild_primeTable 100000 317 14`, an elaborator command tied to the prime-table module; 340 bytes, no hard-exclusion invariant established, retained.

experiments/CadSampleCosts/Kahan/Literal.lean and Kahan/Kernel.lean: read completely; defs `input`/`certificate` and theorems `correspondence` and `accepted : certificate.check input = true := by decide +kernel`; formal content.

experiments/CadSampleCosts/Fixtures.lean (39059 bytes): head read; `syntax`/`macro_rules` definitions of RCF sentences and cell certificates (Sturm chains, isolation intervals) consumed by the per-example theorems; formal certificate data, retained.

HexManual/Chapters/HexMvGcd.lean: head read; Verso `#doc (Manual)` chapter with mathematical exposition and `{docstring Hex.MvPoly.divMod_spec}` style references to named theorems; six manual chapters have no ```lean blocks but all cite declarations, retained as interface documentation.
summary: Surveyed all 234 listed .lean files (paths and byte sizes) under HexBareissMathlib, HexECPP, HexGFqMathlib, HexGFqRing, HexGramSchmidt, HexLLL, HexManual, HexRCF, HexRealAlgebraic, HexSmith, experiments/ and scripts/. A per-file line-start grep for theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque (with private/meta/noncomputable/public modifiers) plus macro/syntax/elab/#eval/#doc commands found 8 files with zero matches; all 8 were read completely, plus sample small experiment files, the head of experiments/CadSampleCosts/Fixtures.lean and HexManual/Chapters/HexMvGcd.lean. Every file carries formal content or module-level navigation: Lean definitions and proofs, certificate terms and checked theorems, #cad_emit commands stating real-arithmetic propositions, Verso manual chapters that cite named declarations via docstring directives, or import-only re-export modules that FILTER-007 keeps primary-eligible. Disposition: retain all; no exclusions.
